Subject: Hands-on lab — dry run & routing playbook (POC)

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I want to lock in a short dry run ahead of the full hands-on session so we can validate connectivity, prompt routing, and a brief load verification before the customer-facing lab. Proposed plan below:

- Purpose: verify staging connectivity + review routing prompts + a 30-45m stress window at low concurrency.
- Duration: 90 minutes total (30m prompt review & routing, 45m hands-on, 15m wrap).
- Candidate slots (PST):
  • Tue Oct 20 — 09:30–11:00
  • Wed Oct 21 — 10:00–11:30  (preferred by our infra team)
  • Thu Oct 22 — 13:00–14:30

Preflight checklist (what we need from your side):
1) Temporary sandbox accounts for the Helios dev team (user list + emails).
2) Staging endpoint URL and allowlist IPs (we can provide the template).
3) API key for staging (we will send a short-lived key; please indicate any rotation windows).
4) Prompt bundle you want us to exercise (max 6 prompts; ideally include expected routing policies).
5) Any maintenance windows or blackout periods on Oct 20–22.

Attached: poc-dryrun-checklist.pdf and network-allowlist-template.txt. I also dropped an editable checklist in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XabcDryRunPlaybook

If Wed 10:00–11:30 works for you, we’ll schedule and I’ll loop in Marcus (solutions eng) and Monica (CS) for the technical run and success criteria. If you need to shift, please tell me preferred days/times and your IT contact so we can get allowlist set up.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Olga —

Thanks — this looks good. Quick note from our side: we have a planned maintenance window on Tue Oct 20 between 08:00–10:00 PST, so that slot would be risky for our staging cluster.

Wed Oct 21 10:00–11:30 PST works well for the Helios dev and product SMEs — can you hold that? I’ve looped in Ajit (IT) to get the allowlist and temporary sandbox accounts sorted.

Also attaching a short security questionnaire (helios-security-questions.xlsx) — Ajit will handle the technical answers but we wanted to surface it before the dry run.

Two asks from my side:
- Can you confirm whether the stress window will be read-only traffic or will it exercise write flows? (We prefer read-only for the dry run.)
- Do you need any elevated logging on our side for the prompt trace?

Appreciate it — Leah

Leah — great, Wed Oct 21 10:00–11:30 PST is penciled in. To clarify on the two items:

- Stress traffic: we’ll run read-only flows for the dry run (no write/production-side effects). Full write-path tests can be scheduled later if you want to validate end-to-end.
- Elevated logging: useful for tracing prompts — if Ajit can enable request-level logs for the staging prefix for the 10:00–11:30 window, we’ll correlate on our side.

Marcus / Monica — can you confirm the following by EOD Monday so I can finalize calendar invites and send a short runbook to Helios?
  1) Can Marcus provision a short-lived staging API key that matches the allowlist template?
  2) Can Marcus run a 30–45m low-concurrency stress window (target 5–10 rps peak) and monitor latency/error budgets?
  3) Monica: confirm we have the customer success checklist and the prompt bundle review deck ready.

Thanks team — I’ve attached the Helios questionnaire Ajit will fill and the checklist.
